sloka: उपवासम् अथो शस्त्रम् प्रचरिष्यन्ति वानराः ।घोरम् आरोदनम् मन्ये गते मयि भविष्यति ॥५-१३-३७॥
transliteration: upavāsam atho śastram pracariṣyanti vānarāḥ ।ghoram ārodanam manye gate mayi bhaviṣyati ॥5-13-37॥

translations.english: "If I go there (without finding Sita), it will cause destruction of the Ikshvakus and vanaras would weep. It would be dreadful.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर हनुमानजी ने सुनहले रङ्ग का शिशुपा वृक्ष देखा । उसका थेंबला) सोने का वना हुआ था
